items.question: Can you arrange airport pickups?
items.answer: Airport pickup and drop-off enquiries are welcome. Availability and prices are confirmed before booking.

items.question: Do your packages include hotels?
items.answer: Not automatically. Hotel arrangements are included only if expressly confirmed in your quotation.

items.question: Can we change stops during the tour?
items.answer: Talk with the team about adjustments; changes depend on timing, distance, and any agreed booking terms.
